parameters.parameterName: Conductor material and construction
parameters.expected: Plain copper or aluminium per IS 8130 (mining/gassy-mine cables: copper only; tinned copper by agreement). Construction: Al 1.5 mm² solid Class 1; Cu 1.5-6 / Al 2.5-10 mm² solid (Class 1) or stranded (Class 2); Cu ≥ 10 / Al ≥ 16 mm² stranded Class 2. Optional protective barrier compatible with insulation

parameters.parameterName: Conductor resistance at 20 °C
parameters.expected: Per IS 8130 for the class of conductor (routine + acceptance + type test)

parameters.parameterName: Inner sheath thickness, Min (by calculated diameter over laid-up cores)
parameters.expected: Up to 25 mm → 0.3; over 25-35 → 0.4; over 35-45 → 0.5; over 45-55 → 0.6; over 55 → 0.7 (single-core cables have no inner sheath; binder tape not counted)

parameters.parameterName: Armour coverage, Min
parameters.expected: Round/formed wires applied as closely as practicable; coverage = (N × d / W) × 100 per Annex C

parameters.parameterName: Armour wire dimensions (by calculated diameter under armour)
parameters.expected: Method A: > 13 mm — formed wire 0.8 mm. Method B: ≤ 13 mm — round 1.4; 13-25 — formed 0.8 / round 1.6; 25-40 — formed 0.8 / round 2.0; 40-55 — formed 1.4 / round 2.50; 55-70 — formed 1.4 / round 3.15; > 70 — formed 1.4 / round 4.00. ≤ 13 mm below armour → round wires; tolerance per IS 3975 (formed: dimensions A and C only)

parameters.parameterName: Armour wire tensile strength
Armour wire elongation at break, Min
Armour wire — torsion, winding, zinc coating, resistivity
parameters.expected: Torsion per Table 6 of IS 3975 (round); winding test — zinc coating no cracks/flaking (formed); uniformity of zinc per IS 3975 (dips reduced by one half-minute; formed: face only); mass of zinc ≥ 95 percent of Table 2 of IS 4826 (round) / IS 3975 (formed); resistivity per IS 3975

parameters.parameterName: Armour application — lay, joints, layers
parameters.expected: Left-hand lay (inner layer for double armour; outer layer reverse with non-hygroscopic separator); joints brazed/welded, irregularities removed, ≥ 300 mm from nearest joint in any other wire/strip; optional binder tape

parameters.parameterName: Armour resistance (mining cables), Max
parameters.expected: Not more than conductor resistance per IS 8130 + 33 percent; substitution of steel by tinned copper wires/strips permissible. (Routine test for mining cables; optional for others; dc armour resistance at 20 °C per purchaser declaration if specified)

parameters.parameterName: Outer sheath thickness (by calculated diameter under outer sheath)
parameters.expected: Unarmoured: average ≥ nominal col (3), smallest ≥ minimum col (4); armoured: ≥ minimum col (5). Bands (over-incl → nominal / min): ≤15 → 1.8/1.24; 15-25 → 2.0/1.40; 25-35 → 2.2/1.56; 35-40 → 2.4/1.72; 40-45 → 2.6/1.88; 45-50 → 2.8/2.04; 50-55 → 3.0/2.20; 55-60 → 3.2/2.36; 60-65 → 3.4/2.52; 65-70 → 3.6/2.68; 70-75 → 3.8/2.84; 75-85 → 4.0/3.00 (armoured min = same as col 4). Multi-core unarmoured single-extrusion: thickness ≥ Table 5 + Table 7 values

parameters.parameterName: Outer sheath material and application
parameters.expected: PVC type ST2 of IS 5831 (C1/C2: ST2 with suitable additives), or PE per Table 1A, or LSHF per Table 1B; extruded over insulation (unarmoured single-core) / inner sheath (unarmoured multi-core) / armour (armoured); colour black or as agreed

parameters.parameterName: High voltage test at room temperature
parameters.expected: Withstand 3 kV ac rms (40-60 Hz) or 7.2 kV dc, between conductors and conductors-to-ECC (if any), 5 min per test connection (routine + acceptance + type)

parameters.parameterName: Flame retardance — single cable (OD < 35 mm)
parameters.expected: No visible damage within 300 mm from upper end of specimen (soot, mixing-device marks, colour change not counted)

parameters.parameterName: Flame retardance — bunched cables, charred height Max
parameters.expected: Charred/affected portion ≤ 2.5 m above bottom edge of burner (front and rear); Category B/C methods of Part 62

Core identification and laying up
parameters.expected: Core colours: 1-core red/black/yellow/blue/natural; 2-core red+black; 3-core red+yellow+blue; 4-core +black; 5-core +grey; ≥ 6 cores: blue+yellow counting/direction cores per layer, rest grey — or numbered cores (strips/printing; ≤ 4 cores 0-3; > 4 cores sequential from 1). Reduced neutral core black / number 0. Lay-up: outermost layer right-hand lay, successive opposite; recommended plan per Table 4 (guidance; printed table skips 80)

parameters.parameterName: Cable identification and code
parameters.expected: Manufacturer name/trademark (tape, indent, print or emboss on outer sheath, ≤ 1 m spacing); word ELECTRIC throughout; MINING for mines cables; FR (C1) / FR-LSH (C2) / LSHF (C3); "d.c. cable" for single-core magnetic-armour dc cables. Code letters: A aluminium; 2X XLPE; W / Wa round-wire armour (steel/non-magnetic); F / Fa strip armour; FF / WW double armour; Y PVC sheath; 2Y PE sheath; Z LSHF sheath; no letter for copper conductor

parameters.parameterName: Packing and drum marking
parameters.expected: Wound on drum (IS 10418), ends sealed non-hygroscopic; drum/label: IS 7098 (Part 1), manufacturer, type and voltage grade, cores, cross-sectional area, cable code, length, number of lengths, rotation arrow, gross mass, country and year of manufacture; optional Standard Mark (BIS Act 2016)
